==Skin Trivia==
*The {{Color|Premium|Wraith}} skin was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/51984102/profile Kirbylittle].
*The {{Color|Premium|Partisan}} skin was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/49527545/profile ingvaras123].
*The first version of the Default, {{Color|Basic|Green}}, {{Color|Basic|Blue}} and {{Color|Basic|Black Ops}} Level 5 laser rifle was from another game, ''R2DA''. It is known as the [[w:c:r2da:FATAL6|FATAL6]] which only BelowNatural and ''R2DA's'' creator, PlaceRebuilder, have exclusive permission to use.
**The '''Ranger's''' Level 4 upgrade icon still shows the laser rifle.
*The first and second version of the Default Level 4 cape was loosely based on [[wp:Star-Lord|Star Lord]] from [[wp:Guardians of the Galaxy (film)|Guardians of the Galaxy]].
*On the [[Christmas 2019 Event]] [[Thumbnails|thumbnail]], the '''Ranger''' has an appearance that looks like a mix of the original Default skin and {{Color|Mission|Railgunner}} skin.
**This appearance was never seen in-game with any skin.
*The {{Color|Deluxe|Gun Gale}} skin is based on [[w:c:swordartonline:Asada Shino|Shino Asada]] from the ''Sword Art Online Series''.
*The {{Color|Mission|Railgunner}} skin is based on the [https://riskofrain2.wiki.gg/wiki/Railgunner Character of the same name] from ''Risk of Rain 2''.
**The Level 4 of the {{Color|Mission|Railgunner}} also references the [https://riskofrainreturns.wiki.gg/wiki/Sniper Sniper] from ''Risk of Rain Returns''.
*The {{Color|Premium|Classic}} skin is based on the fourth version of the Default skin.
**The {{Color|Premium|Classic}} '''Ranger''' does not resemble its BETA version, unlike the [[Shotgunner/Gallery|{{Color|Premium|Classic}} Shotgunner]], [[Military Base/Gallery|{{Color|Premium|Classic}} Military Base]] and [[Militant/Gallery|{{Color|Other|John}} Militant]].
*The {{Color|Mission|Badlands}} skin is based on the [[w:c:fallout:NCR Veteran Ranger|NCR Veteran Ranger]] from ''Fallout: New Vegas''.
**The weapons used are also based on weapons from ''Fallout: New Vegas'', with Level 0-3 bearing the [[w:c:fallout:Anti-materiel rifle|Anti-Material Rifle]], while the gauss rifle used at Level 4 is [[w:c:fallout:YCS/186|YCS/186]].
*The {{Color|ContentCreator|Propellars}} skin is based on [https://www.youtube.com/c/propellars propellars].
*The {{Color|ContentCreator|5ouls}} skin is based on [https://www.youtube.com/@5ouIs 5ouls].
**This skin was made as a reward for being one of the first people to triumph [[Infernal Abyss]] on [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode, alongside [https://www.youtube.com/@CrazRex CrazRex] and [https://www.youtube.com/@DanksPlatter DanksPlatter]. All of them received a skin.
**The skin was made by [https://www.youtube.com/@5ouIs 5ouls] himself.

*The {{Color|Beach|Axolotl}} skin model was made by 5ouls<ref>https://x.com/_5ouIs/status/2073078013365784761</ref> while the concept art for it was made by colca.<ref>https://x.com/_5ouIs/status/2073078016201162761</ref>.
*The {{Color|Beach|Aquatic}} skin model was made by Gab7497<ref>https://x.com/Gab7497/status/2073077661400744062</ref> while its concept art was made by UnknownCanvas.<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/TDS_Roblox/s/5dJHr1JXV3</ref>
